_: Timed windows and what they open and close, read by server/events.py (its docstring has the format): windows (daily times, windows laid over another's openings, calendar dates), spawns (the creatures of a location's own file that stand only while a window is open), held_out (of a file's own, never), quests (rows on offer only while a window is open), loot (a thing creatures carry in certain places), keep_in (things that exist in certain places only). The clock is the bosses' (server/bosses.py: Moscow time, LAVA_BOSS_CLOCK for a test), and nothing here is remembered: a server restarted in a window is in it. World bosses spawn every two hours at even Moscow hours, the warehouse masters once a day at 20:00 (bosses.py); the rest keeps the times the map labels and the texts give. Every row says whether it is RECOVERED or DESIGNED.

prison_wh.why: RECOVERED. The uprising in Вади-Хальфа's prison (m8, the blocks 644-648 under the yard 176, 5985,1744): the yard's map label «Усиление режима в 12:00, 16:00 и 23:00» (res/database/locations.xml; the wiki's «Тюрьма Вади-Хальфы» the same), and the guard's call 62258: «каждый день в 12:00, 16:00 и 23:00 заключенным требуется усиленная охрана, длится это безобразие недолго, всего пол часа», its hint «"Охранять" заключенных нужно в течение 30 минут» (62272). The prisoners and the godfather stand while it is open. Not the bosses' 14/18/22: the owner's rule is for world bosses and camp chiefs, and the prison keeps the times its label gives. Owner update 2026-10-27: start at 13:00, 17:00, 21:00 Moscow time to avoid even-hour world boss starts; duration and relative gates/medic offsets unchanged.

keep_in.why: RECOVERED rule. Томас, who leads out of the prison, «При выходе отбирает все повязки» (the wiki's «Томас»): the armbands stay in the blocks, whichever way the player leaves -- Томас's «Выход», a death sent home, a login elsewhere. DESIGNED: and no other way either -- the frame of a thing kept in carries the quest flag and no exchange (server/events.py kept, items.static_info), so no letter, lot, barter or stall takes one out, and a death does not drop it. Since 2026-10-13 (the owner's «и потом сделай донголу тоже», 2026-10-13) the row holds Донгола's blocks too, 618-622: one row for the one armband of both prisons, since server/events.py take_back reads every keep_in row on its own -- a second row for 2476 would take the armbands away in Донгола's blocks for not being Вади-Хальфа's, and the other way round. The prisons touch nowhere: leaving either is leaving the row's places. Since 2026-10-14 (the owner's «сделай потом абу хамед в таком же формате», 2026-10-14) the row holds Абу-Хамед's blocks too, 649-653, by the same rule: one row for the one armband of the three prisons.
